{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Americans expressed dismay that people willing to study and work cannot get a job that pays enough to live on in the current economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to an economic policy that produces good jobs with good pay and benefits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support the right to organize.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When unions are allowed to do their job of making sure that workers get their fair share, they pull people out of poverty and create a stronger middle class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen the ability of workers to organize unions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to pass the Employee Free Choice Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore pro-worker voices to the National Labor Relations Board and the National Mediation Board.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support overturning the NLRB's and NMB's many harmful decisions that undermine the collective bargaining rights of millions of workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that federal employees, including public safety officers who put their lives on the line every day, have the right to bargain collectively.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fix the broken bargaining process at the Federal Aviation Administration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to ban the permanent replacement of striking workers, so that workers can stand up for themselves without worrying about losing their livelihoods.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to vigorously oppose \"Right-to-Work\" Laws and \"paycheck protection\" efforts whenever they are proposed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Suspending labor protections during national emergencies compounds the devastation from the emergency.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
